The Vision & Origins

Ancient Serenity Meets Modern Living

Taxila Satellite Township is a residential township by Minawa Group, adjacent to the University of Engineering & Technology (UET) Taxila. It lies in Mouza Toffkian, Tehsil Khanpur, District Haripur, with its site office on Canal Road — in the historic Taxila valley, home to the heritage of ancient Gandhara.

Spread over 164 Kanal 10 Marla, the township is planned in Blocks A, B, C and E, with 67.384 Kanal set aside for amenities — parks and open spaces, a mosque, commercial areas, public buildings and roads. The scheme is NOC-approved by TMA Khanpur.

Lifestyle & Amenities

Amenities for Everyday Living

67.384 Kanal of the township is set aside for amenities — parks, a mosque, commercial areas, public buildings, a graveyard and roads.

  • Spiritual

    Jamia Mosque

    A domed mosque with carved jali screens and an arched gateway, at the heart of the community.

  • Recreation

    Parks & Open Spaces

    Parks and open spaces set aside within the township.

  • Commercial

    Commercial Areas

    Designated commercial areas for everyday shopping and services within the township.

  • Security

    Gated Main Entrance

    A gated main entrance with guard posts and boom barriers.

  • Infrastructure

    Road Network
